Marketo Engage is a comprehensive, AI-powered marketing automation platform that enables teams to scale personalized buyer engagement and drive predictable pipeline and revenue growth. As a centralized hub for cross-channel campaign orchestration and execution, Adobe Marketo Engage supports businesses of all sizes—helping them acquire, nurture, expand, and retain customers along complex buying journeys. Whether you’re a fast-growing small business or a global enterprise, Marketo Engage empowers marketing teams to launch more campaigns, generate more sales-ready leads, and boost sales performance.

Adobe Analytics offers comprehensive web, product, and experience analytics to give you a complete view of how users interact across digital channels. By capturing real-time behavioral data—page visits, feature usage, and content engagement—you can spot trends, identify bottlenecks, and refine user journeys. This holistic perspective allows you to improve site performance, streamline product interfaces, and enhance overall customer experiences. With actionable insights at your fingertips, you can drive growth, strengthen brand loyalty, and stay one step ahead in a competitive landscape.

Adobe Journey Optimizer is a customer engagement solution for orchestrating and delivering omnichannel personalized experiences at the moments that matter most. Users can manage, personalize, and optimize messages using authoring options and a centralized asset library for faster content creation. AI-powered capabilities drive optimization, experimentation, and content creation. By consolidating fragmented customer engagement tools into one platform, brands can streamline operations, eliminate data silos, and deliver seamless, impactful customer experiences that foster growth and loyalty.

description: Maestra is an all-in-one personalization platform for DTC brands. Its core is a real-time CDP that provides unified customer profiles, identity resolution, and granular segmentation (nested segments, calculated and custom fields). It supports omnichannel messaging across email, SMS, MMS, RCS, push, messaging apps, chatbots, paid media, and even offline stores. Maestra enables site and app personalization with pop-ups, stories, banners and bars, surveys, and other dynamic blocks. It also offers AI-driven recommendations, product-discovery quizzes, and product visuals for ads. The platform allows brands to build flexible loyalty programs, laser-targeted promotions, and referral systems. Maestra includes analytics with detailed reporting and configurable attribution. White-glove service is part of every Maestra subscription: each client gets a dedicated Forward Deployed Marketer who helps with everything from integrations to strategy through a shared Slack channel and weekly Zoom calls.
